prompt_text: Which title company in Fort Lauderdale FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” choice, but **Palm Title Partners** looks like a solid option to contact first: it has a Fort Lauderdale office downtown and customer testimonials describing smooth, communicative closings. **Independence Title** is another candidate, with local reviews highlighting responsiveness and experience with residential and more complicated transactions.

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm they regularly handle your type of transaction, and check that your lender will accept them. In Florida, the buyer and seller can often negotiate who selects the title company, so check your contract too.

- [Palm Title Partners](https://palmtitle.com/) — 100 NE 3rd Ave., Suite 610; (954) 824-9920  
- [Independence Title](https://titlerate.com/) — 4700 W. Prospect Rd., Suite 115; (954) 335-9305

Reviews are only one signal; compare the actual service, fees, and availability for your closing date.
